title: astragalus alpinus var. americanus
intro: Astragalus alpinus var. americanus, commonly known as Western milkvetch, is a perennial legume native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include supporting immune function, reducing inflammation, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus alpinus var. americanus may include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its therapeutic properties, which have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote overall well-being and support health.
